title: Autumn Draped Table
desc: An autumn table finished with warm drapery and orange blooms.

groups.label: Feature flowers
groups.blurb: The saturated orange-and-yellow canopy over the table.

items.role: Vivid orange hydrangea anchoring the top-left canopy.
Deep yellow hydrangea poms carrying the yellow half of the canopy (fluffy backup: Bread Hydrangea - Yellow).
Yellow oncidium sprays trailing beneath the canopy over the drapes.
Yellow-toned spray roses scattered through the arrangement (closest yellow — orange-yellow roses are a logged gap).
Orange multi-head spider mums deepening the autumn tones (caramel backup: Flame Chrysanthemum - Coffee).

groups.label: Accents & fills
groups.blurb: Small faces and soft bells between the big blooms.

items.role: Yellow aster-style daisies scattered across the ground clusters.
Caramel bell-flower spikes echoing the burnt tones (bell form matched).

groups.label: Foliage & styling
groups.blurb: Greens, grasses and the table dressing.

items.role: Round eucalyptus leaves peeking between the warm blooms.
Fountain-like grass plumes softening the canopy edges.
Pure white satin tablecloth pooling over the rustic table.
Pearl strands draping from the drape edge over the table.
